restated: For every P-position (p,q,r) of 3-row Chomp with r >= 1, p - q <= 3r - 1. Equivalently, for each fixed r, f(q,r) - q is at most 3r - 1 for every q >= r.
ledger_statement: CORRECTION of C0009 and (Z1). Byrnes' Lemma 5, correctly specialised to 3-row Chomp with the third row fixed, gives p - q <= 3r - 1 for EVERY P-position (p,q,r), uniformly in q. The embedding forced by Byrnes' assumption (1) is C = the row-2 tail, D = the row-1 tail, A = the 3r-1 cells of columns 1..r minus the poison, giving m = q-r and n = p-r. C0009 used n = p-q, which yields the weaker true statement (p-q)-(q-r) <= 3r-1 and a spurious (q-r) term that appears to grow with q. Consequence: (Z1) is NOT half-proved, it is fully proved in print with C = 3, and M_r <= 3r-2. The 'residual half of (Z1)' that the Phase 0 audit set as island 01's opening target does not exist.

verdicts.gap_description: no parseable verdict: the referee did not finish. This is a harness failure and says nothing about the claim.

The submission uses the asserted Lemma 5 (n - m <= |A| + k when g(A_{m,n}) = k) with k = 0, m = q-r, n = p-r, |A| = 3r-1. This derivation does not follow from the proof as presented: the cited lemma is applied to the poset (p,q,r) only under the stated assumption 'no element of C is less than an element of D', but Lemma 5's definition of A_{m,n} = A ∪ C ∪ D − {x : x >= c_{m+1}} − {x : x >= d_{n+1}} with these roles forces p = r+min(m,n), so one of p = q or p <= q results; a general Chomp position with p > q > r does not have this additive/disjoint decomposition of A_{m,n} into (3r-1) + (q-r) + (p-r) cells. The author's own displayed computation A_{m,n} = (r+n, r+min(m,n), r) shows that only n - min(m,n) (not n - m) is controlled, i.e. it yields p - q <= 3r-1 only when q = r.

verdicts.effectivity_check: The proof produces no computable N(r)-bound at all: it only reasserts the uniform numerical inequality p - q <= 3r - 1 and never produces a line defining or bounding N(r). If the inequality were valid it would trivially imply the effective preperiod bound N(r) <= 3r-1 via p = q + d with d in the bounded finite set, but the inequality itself is what fails under the stated embedding.
